title: Version 1 Linear parent/context records
description: Owner-approved additive representation contract. Offline fixture checks do not implement auth, ingestion, persistence, recovery or live integrations.

opaque_id.description: Registered metadata identifier; syntax never grants authority or permits encoded content.

uuid.description: Provider-native UUID, never a name, URL, credential or encoded work content.

version_ref.description: Immutable version identity; digest is not authorization or live-source proof.

work_scope_ref.description: Exact event-time same-tenant registry version; no rebinding historical evidence.

external_object.description: Provider-native typed identity in the authenticated workspace, separate from the Hormuz work hierarchy.

relationship.description: Typed parent of the event object. No self-reference. Relationships are observations, never authority/AI attribution. Multiple initiative/project relations do not select a primary parent.

revision.description: Only verified source counters/updated timestamps in one ordering domain are comparable. UUID, delivery ID or receipt time is not source order.

binding.description: Immutable binding as of known source time with independently authorized entity scope. Current parents never retarget old facts.

hormuz.linear-context-event.description: Planned authenticated metadata-only source observation. Existing issue lifecycle outcomes remain in the frozen work-outcome record. Context neither replaces nor counts as an outcome; fixture validation is not source authentication.

hormuz.linear-context-page.description: Separate planned administrator collection. Cursor binds tenant, actor/roles, connector authority, filters, snapshot, schema/order and retention generation. No frozen outcome page/route change.

hormuz.linear-context-retention.description: Separate append-only operator retention marker, not a provider deletion or outcome. Invalidates cursors; never erases linked financial/audit facts or claims backup erasure.

x-hormuz-domain-rules.compatibility: Keep frozen issue/PR outcome event/page/receipt, project-binding configuration and route/CLI/manifest contracts unchanged. Initiative/project/cycle and relationship context use these new IDs; no entity relabeling or issue-only scope reduction.
x-hormuz-domain-rules.authentication_gate: #220 must freeze raw-byte HMAC, independently authenticated workspace/team/webhook and explicitly typed entity/container authority, permission checks, rotation and durable replay identity. Existing project-only enrollment is not permission for every initiative, cycle or team. Output fields are not credentials or authority.
x-hormuz-domain-rules.provider_mapping_gate: Normalized representation types are not proof of supported provider payload/actions. #220 must pin/test the actual entity/action/state/relationship mapping and API/schema revision. Unknown/malformed data causes no normalized mutation. All four entity types remain in scope.
x-hormuz-domain-rules.relationships: Typed parent sets stay separate from the Hormuz hierarchy. Never infer authority, AI attribution, ownership or primary initiative. Partial/missing coverage cannot remove earlier links; only complete comparable revisions may replace the current projection. Changes append facts; old context never retargets. A non-null supersedes_context_event_id additionally requires a known revision, current ordering state and complete relationship coverage, including an explicitly complete empty set when no parents apply.
x-hormuz-domain-rules.privacy: Raw context/retention is portfolio_admin only. Finance/platform/team/self gain no raw source/peer access. #223 aggregate views must authorize before lookup/join and not leak private-team projects through public initiatives. Reader and source authority are independent.
x-hormuz-domain-rules.ordering: Preserve source/observed/commit times; unknown source time stays null and unmatched. Same authenticated identity/bytes replays original receipt; conflicts fail closed. UUID/delivery order is not source order. Compare only in the same trusted domain; late/equal-conflicting/incomparable facts never overwrite newer authoritative state. No provider-work replay.
x-hormuz-domain-rules.retention: Separate authorized append-only retention marker, audit and idempotency. Logical tombstone hides target and invalidates old cursor generations without resurrecting older state. Source deletion is distinct. Preserve linked finance/audit facts; no universal erasure.
x-hormuz-domain-rules.pagination: Default 50, max 100, one-hour cursor TTL; descending event_at with observed_at fallback, connector_id, context_event_id. Freeze sequence/as_of, filters, authority and retention generation. Reject scope/filter/order drift before query. Time fallback is ordering only, not source fact. Each stored context record carries a positive server-assigned commit_sequence from the organization's context stream. Items must have distinct commit sequences at or below snapshot_sequence. Cross-component ingested_at/as_of comparisons never establish membership; sequence fields in synthetic fixtures do not prove actual database membership.
x-hormuz-domain-rules.delivery_gate: Maximum 1 MiB record/page, 100 relationships/teams; provider ingress depth 16 and 4096 JSON members. #220 must prove end-to-end durable acknowledgment within Linear's documented 5-second response limit including auth/read/parse/commit. Per-statement limits are not that proof; no ingress activated. The offline emitted-payload check uses the 1 MiB compact ASCII JSON byte limit; no smaller aggregate-member cap overrides valid wire arrays. Provider-ingress limits are a separate future receiver boundary.
x-hormuz-domain-rules.claims: Descriptive metadata only, inconclusive association eligibility; no content, credentials, names, titles, URLs, rankings or causal claims. Synthetic verified_connector fixtures are not live proof. Live workspace/webhook authorization and #225 pilot consent are separate.
